review_type: source inspection after author freeze; focused test logs inspected, not independently rerun
findings: One communicator thread submits payload exactly once and owns communicate; the parent never retries partial stdin submission.
Event publication precedes parent consumption of either completed output or captured worker exception.
Cancellation and deadline checks execute in the caller thread before and after completion polling.
Event construction, Thread construction and Thread.start are within the launched child cleanup scope.
Cleanup kills a live direct child, waits for process exit, joins a started communicator, then closes all three pipe streams.
Worker OSError and setup RuntimeError/OSError become NormalWorkerError; caller check exceptions retain their original type.
The added regression test injects communication and Event/Thread construction/start failures and checks direct-child reaping and pipe closure.
scope: Existing controlled direct-child Regina worker contract; no change to process-group or inherited-grandchild-pipe semantics.
